_comment: Hand-labeled ground truth for scripts/ocr_eval.py. Keyed by screenshot FILENAME; the images themselves are NOT committed (they contain player usernames + are large), only the anonymized stat values. `complete: true` = the listed stats are ALL stats visible on that sheet (extras the OCR finds count as false positives); `false` = a partial label (e.g. an equipment view showing only Power Rank), where extras aren't penalised. Percent stats are stored as the displayed number without the % sign. Extend this by adding entries for more screenshots; re-run `python scripts/ocr_eval.py --images-dir <folder>` (needs the OCR engine, i.e. the deployed image).

2026-06-15_1515969672875479101_2026-06-1.note: Clean English full stat sheet (Shadow Hunter). Two-column VALUE-after / LABEL-after mix. Values verified against a 5x-upscaled crop (the 412px source was too small to eyeball reliably).

2026-05-14_1504582718074257488_Capture_d.note: English game on a French OS, VALUE-before-LABEL layout, with header junk (Total MR / Geode MR) that must be ignored. Values verified against upscaled crops; the initial hand-transcription from the 390px thumbnail had 5 errors (physical_damage, critical_hit, coefficient, energy_regen[was Stability's value], attack_speed) - all of which the OCR had read correctly.

2026-05-11_1503525595345326150_Capture_d.note: French client EQUIPMENT view (not the stat sheet) - only Power Rank is shown (Rg de pouvoir). Tests the French power_rank synonym + that no other label is hallucinated.
